name: com.teosretreats.www/core-breath-retreats
title: Core Breath Retreats
description: Sacred-medicine retreats near Quito: schedule, ceremonies, medicines, healers, pricing, booking.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Lightweight liveness probe for the Core Breath Retreats API.

tools.name: list_schedule
tools.description: List the multi-day retreat schedule (month, dates, retreat, shaman, duration, price). Use this when a client asks what retreats are coming up or when the next Ayahuasca or San Pedro retreat runs.

tools.name: list_ceremonies
tools.description: List upcoming short one- or two-night ceremonies near Quito (title, medicine, dates, city, status). Use this for clients already in Ecuador who want a single ceremony rather than a multi-day retreat. Private venue and price details are intentionally omitted.

tools.name: list_medicines
tools.description: List the plant medicines and ceremonies we work with (Ayahuasca, San Pedro/Wachuma, Kambo, Temazcal, sacred mushrooms, yopo) and the tradition each is held in. Use this when a client asks which medicines you use or what the differences are.

tools.name: list_healers
tools.description: List the shamans and healers who hold our ceremonies (Taita Hernán Toapanta, Taita Alirio Causaluzán, Gabriel Guillén) plus the therapists and facilitators on our support team. Use this when a client asks who the healers or shamans are.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Retreat pricing, what is included, and how booking/deposit works. Use this when a client asks how much a retreat costs or what the price covers. Prices for private and small-circle retreats are custom; relay that a quote is sent within a day of inquiry.

tools.name: get_private_retreats
tools.description: Private and custom-tailored retreat options: private one-on-one, couples, small private circles (under 6), fully custom journeys, and veterans small-unit retreats, plus how they're priced and booked. Use this when a client wants something more personal than the published group dates, or asks about a private/custom retreat.

tools.name: submit_booking_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a booking or question request on the client's behalf. This writes through the SAME funnel as the website contact form and is answered by a real person within 24-48 hours. REQUIREMENTS: only submit the client's OWN contact details, with their explicit consent; never invent a name, email or phone number. A deposit and payment are arranged by the human team afterwards — this tool does not take payment.

message.description: What they want: a specific retreat, private trip, question, etc. (required).

email.description: Client's email. Optional, but at least one of email or phone is required.

phone.description: Client's WhatsApp/phone number. Optional, but at least one of email or phone is required.

retreat_interest.description: Which retreat or medicine they are interested in, if known.

retreat_type.description: The type of booking. Use 'private' for one-on-one, 'couple' for a couple/partnered retreat, 'small-circle' for under 6 people, 'custom' for a fully tailored journey, 'ceremony' for a single short ceremony, 'group' for the published group dates.
